annotations.text:
Charging in the app — the oven is off, so temperature controls and heating modes have nothing to act on.

A keeps the dial and re-points it at the battery. B keeps the dial meaning temperature and puts charging in a card where the controls were. C drops everything else.

Lock Screen, three states of one card.

The question running through all of them: should the three states share one skeleton so the eye learns a single layout (U-A, C-A, S-A), or should each state take the shape that suits it (C-B's battery, S-B's one line)?

Mixing is fine — but a shared skeleton only pays off if you take it in all three.
No buttons on any of these: you said you did not need them, and iOS only allows them from 17 anyway.
